column3: Close macro of a weathered hand lifting the lid off a blackened earthen claypot, a thick bloom of steam rising into the dark, glimpse of red crab curry inside, glowing coals below.
Skewers of spiced chicken and charred vegetables (aubergine, peppers, onions) grilling over glowing coals on a banana leaf, smoke curling, rustic dark wood.
A slice of Goan bebinca, many thin caramel-brown layers, on a dark stoneware plate with grated coconut and a drizzle of jaggery syrup, candlelight.
A single candle in a brass holder on a dark teak table beside a folded linen napkin and a sprig of curry leaves, banana leaves blurred behind, night.
Woven rattan lanterns glowing among large banana leaves and palms at night, warm light on dark foliage, no people.
